verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs show it creates investigations when monitoring thresholds are met, and that manual reviews happen as events, so a case-review surface exists. Nothing documents assigning cases to analysts or routing them through review and escalation stages. Missing for 10: case assignment to analysts, configurable review/escalation stage routing, queue or workflow-state documentation for investigations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met
asynchronous events like when a watchlist gets updated or a manual review occurs
These endpoints are deprecated in favor of using Investigations.
